name: Count
summary: Collaborative analytics canvas where teams and an AI agent explore data together, with a free plan and a Pro plan billed per editor.
description: Collaborative analytics canvas where teams and an AI agent explore data together, with a free plan and a Pro plan billed per editor.

pricing.details: Free 0 €, no card — 1 project, 3 canvases, up to 5 users, daily AI credit limits (limited models), 1 database/MCP connection, web search, file uploads, 2 automations, community support. Pro 44 € / editor / month, viewers free — everything in Free plus unlimited AI credits (Count reports that 98% of teams never need to top up), unlimited canvases, projects, reports and automations, 3 database/MCP connections, shared agent skills, 4 GB compute, Slack integration and MCP client, email/Slack/Teams support; workspace users up to 75; owners, admins and editors are billable, viewers and report viewers are free; 14-day version history. Enterprise is let’s talk (unlimited editors, own models or API keys, up to 32 GB compute, SSO, SCIM, HIPAA, EU/US data residency, and others). Only the monthly per-editor price is published; yearly pricing is not shown on the pricing page.
